summary: Helpdesk and ticketing software from Freshworks for email, chat, phone and social support.
access_note: API key from profile settings, sent as HTTP Basic (key as username, X as password). Free trial only; MCP needs Growth plan or above.
blocker_note: Trial only; official MCP is gated to Growth/Pro/Enterprise with monthly action allowances.
notes: MCP endpoint pattern https://<subdomain>.freshdesk.com/mcp comes from a web search summary of the Freshworks article; the fetched page text confirms API-key-only auth and GA date. Freshworks also offers OAuth only for marketplace apps (not verified).

evidence.quote: Your API key will be available below the change password section to your right
Currently, Freshdesk allows you to authenticate requests involved in MCP integration by using an API key only.
Starting September 10, 2026 , the Freshworks MCP integration is generally available.
